question: In 2018, Google Doodle celebrated the 100th birthday of Mrinalini Sarabhai. She is an exponent of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is **Bharatanatyam and Kathakali.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai:-**

 
 
• **She was an Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and instructor.**
 
• She was the founder and director of the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1992 and the Padma Shri in 1965.
 
• She also received many other citations in recognition of her contribution to art.
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai** is an exponent of **Bharatanatyam and Kathakali **dance forms.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam:-**
 
 
• It is one of the **oldest classical dance forms** of India, originating in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is known for its** intricate footwork, hand gestures, facial expressions, and body movements.**
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:-**
 
 
• It​ is a traditional dance form of **Kerala **that combines **dance, music, and acting**.
 
• It is known for its elaborate **costumes, makeup, and facial expressions**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi:-**

 
 
• It​ is a classical dance form of **Odisha **that emphasizes fluid body movements, graceful poses, and storytelling through dance.
 
 
 
• **Kathak:-**
 
 
• It is a classical dance form of** North India** that emphasizes footwork, spins, and storytelling through dance.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi:-**
 
 
• ** **It​** **is a classical dance form of **Andhra Pradesh **that combines dance, music, and acting.
 
• It is known for its **graceful movements and storytelling** through dance.
 
 
 
• **Yakshagana:-**
 
 
• It​ is a traditional dance form of** Karnataka** that combines dance, music, and acting.
 
• It is known for its **colorful costumes, makeup, and storytelling t**hrough dance.
